pairs.registryProposal: decision-records makes a reason mandatory on every rejection, but a single-owner wallet presents refusal as an always-safe walk-away (no money moves); the technique could say whether a safe-direction refusal may carry a closed reason code instead of owner text, since a free-text prompt there adds friction to the option the design most wants to keep cheap.
